sources.title: Company Annual Return Filing FAQ
sources.notes: Official CIPA guidance states company annual returns are filed in the original registration month, with special handling noted for January and December registrations. Requires fresh snapshot review before approval.

sources.title: OBRS Upgrade Public Notice 2025
sources.notes: Official CIPA public notice introducing mandatory constitutions and enhanced beneficial-owner / nominee declarations.

sources.title: Payments & Refunds - All Tax Types
sources.notes: Official BURS payment table: PAYE remittance within 15 days after month end; VAT payment within 25 days after tax period.

sources.title: VAT FAQ
sources.notes: Current BURS VAT FAQ states compulsory registration above P500,000 annual taxable supplies. Conflicts with other official BURS guidance.

sources.title: BURS Registration Guidance
sources.notes: Official BURS registration page states compulsory VAT registration above P1,000,000, with voluntary registration between P500,000 and P1,000,000. Conflicts with current VAT FAQ.

sources.title: VAT Brochure
sources.notes: Official BURS brochure states P1,000,000 compulsory VAT threshold; use only after snapshot verification.

sources.title: Income Tax FAQ
sources.notes: Current BURS FAQ states salary/ITW8 guidance above P3,000 monthly and PAYE due on the 15th following deduction month.

sources.title: Tax FAQ PDF
sources.notes: Official BURS PDF contains older/different ITW8 salary threshold of P2,500 monthly. Treat threshold as conflict until resolved.

sources.title: Labour relations act to commence September
sources.notes: Latest official ministerial statement identified during 31 Aug 2026 review: Employment and Labour Relations Act 2025 commences 1 September 2026.

sources.title: New Act replaces three laws
sources.notes: Current official BOPA report confirms the Employment and Labour Relations Act of 2025 took effect on 1 September 2026. It reports fixed-term contracts limited to 12 months unless clearly justified, probation capped at 6 months, and maternity leave increased to 14 weeks at 70% pay. Treat detailed employment terms as reviewer-controlled draft rules until the underlying Act/regulations are source-snapshotted and approved.

sources.title: Employment Act Comes Into Effect July 1
sources.notes: Earlier official statement gave 1 July 2026 commencement and described fixed-term contracts as limited to 12 months unless objectively justified. Commencement date superseded by later 19 Aug statement.

sources.title: Data Protection Act commencement information
sources.notes: Government publication states Data Protection Act No. 18 of 2024 commenced 14 January 2025.

sources.authority: Government of Botswana - Ministry of Trade
sources.title: Trade Licence / Business Registration eServices
sources.notes: Official trade portal states licences/registration certificates are indefinite and annual fee is 25% of licence/registration fee.

sources.title: Issuance of Industrial Licence
sources.notes: Official government service page: manufacturing enterprises require industrial licence before operations; annual renewal wording and P5m routing threshold.

sources.title: Integrated Procurement Management System
sources.notes: PPRA IPMS states contractors wishing to participate in Government tenders are required to register through IPMS.

sources.title: Pay As You Earn (PAYE)
sources.notes: Official BURS PAYE page states monthly remittance obligations and annual PAYE return/tax-certificate timing within 31 days after the tax year.

sources.title: VAT Act Subsidiary Legislation — Tax Period Categories
sources.notes: Official VAT subsidiary legislation defines Category A and B as two-month tax periods and Category C as monthly; the Commissioner determines category allocation.

sources.authority: Botswana tax legislation / professional tax update
sources.title: Botswana tax reforms effective 1 July 2026
sources.notes: Research source summarises enacted 2026 tax reforms including corporate rate changes, eight-year tax record retention, VAT on remote/digital services and longer input VAT claim period. Use for readiness monitoring; executable rules require primary-source approval.

sources.title: Electronic VAT invoicing framework
sources.notes: Parliamentary record states electronic VAT invoicing framework was introduced and will require VAT-registered businesses to issue digital invoices transmitted to the tax administration system once fully implemented. Product must track readiness without claiming live technical integration.

sources.title: Government e-Procurement system implementation tender
sources.notes: Government procurement for supply, design, development and implementation of an e-Government Procurement system was active in August 2026. Product should track transition readiness rather than duplicate free tender discovery.

sources.title: Tax Administration Act 2026
sources.notes: Primary BURS tax administration legislation includes formal tax-agent registration. The platform remains software; tax return preparation, objections, representation or filing services must be routed through appropriately authorised professionals and explicit taxpayer authority.

rules.title: Company constitution requirement
rules.summary: CIPA's 2025 OBRS notice states all new and existing companies are required to have a constitution.

obligations.title: Maintain current company constitution
obligations.description: Maintain the company's constitution and preserve current evidence in the compliance vault.

rules.title: Beneficial owner declaration
rules.summary: CIPA's 2025 OBRS notice states new and existing companies must declare natural persons with ultimate control/ownership and the nature of their interest.

obligations.title: Maintain beneficial ownership declaration
obligations.description: Review the company's beneficial-owner information and preserve evidence of the current declaration.

rules.title: PAYE remittance deadline
rules.summary: BURS states employer PAYE is payable within 15 days after the end of the month in which it was deductible.

obligation.title: PAYE monthly remittance
obligation.description: Remit PAYE deducted/deductible for the month to BURS within 15 days after month-end.

rules.title: VAT return and payment timing
rules.summary: BURS states VAT returns and VAT payable are due within 25 days after each assigned tax period.

obligation.title: VAT return and payment
obligation.description: Submit the VAT return for the assigned BURS tax period and pay VAT due within 25 days after period-end.

rules.title: Employment and Labour Relations Act 2025 commencement
rules.summary: Official government reporting confirms the Employment and Labour Relations Act of 2025 commenced on 1 September 2026 and is now in effect.

obligations.title: Review employment controls for the new Act
obligations.description: Review current employment contracts, policies and high-risk employment workflows against the approved rule set before relying on them.

rules.title: Fixed-term contract review trigger
rules.summary: Current official government reporting states fixed-term contracts are limited to 12 months unless there is a clear reason for a longer term. This remains a controlled review trigger, not an automated legality conclusion.

obligations.title: Review fixed-term contracts and objective justification
obligations.description: Flag fixed-term contracts approaching or exceeding 12 months for controlled review. Do not automatically decide legality.

rules.title: Probation period review trigger
rules.summary: Current official government reporting states probation is capped at a maximum of 6 months. This draft rule flags probation arrangements for controlled review rather than automatically deciding legality.

obligations.title: Review employee probation periods
obligations.description: Review active probation arrangements against the approved Employment and Labour Relations Act source set, especially any period approaching or exceeding six months. Escalate exceptions for human/legal review rather than making an automatic legal conclusion.

rules.title: Maternity leave control review
rules.summary: Current official government reporting states maternity leave increased to 14 weeks at 70 per cent pay. This draft rule is a policy/control review trigger pending approved primary-source snapshots.

obligations.title: Review maternity leave policy and payroll controls
obligations.description: Review maternity leave policy, payroll configuration and employee communications against the approved Employment and Labour Relations Act source set before relying on the configured entitlement.

rules.title: Trade licence annual fee
rules.summary: Government trade eServices states licences/registration certificates are indefinite and require an annual fee equal to 25% of the licence/registration fee.

obligation.title: Trade licence / registration annual fee
obligation.description: Pay the annual licence/registration fee on the authority-confirmed annual fee date recorded for this licence.

rules.title: Industrial licence before manufacturing operations
rules.summary: Government guidance states manufacturing enterprises require an Industrial Licence before commencement of operations.

obligations.title: Verify Industrial Licence before manufacturing operations
obligations.description: Confirm the applicable industrial licence/registration route and preserve current licence evidence before manufacturing operations.

rules.title: PPRA contractor registration for Government tenders
rules.summary: PPRA IPMS states contractors wishing to participate in Government tenders are required to register through the IPMS system.

obligations.title: Verify PPRA registration before Government tender participation
obligations.description: Confirm the business's PPRA/IPMS registration status where the tender requires contractor registration.

rules.title: Data Protection Act readiness
rules.summary: Government publication states Data Protection Act No. 18 of 2024 commenced on 14 January 2025. Detailed legal obligations remain subject to source-reviewed rule expansion.

obligations.title: Review data-protection controls
obligations.description: Review personal-data inventory, transparency, access, retention, processor and incident controls against approved source-specific obligations.

rules.title: CIPA company annual return
rules.summary: CIPA states companies file an annual return each year in the original registration month, with January registrations due in February and December registrations due in November.

obligation.title: CIPA annual return
obligation.description: File and pay the company annual return within the applicable CIPA due month.

rules.title: CIPA business-name renewal
rules.summary: CIPA guidance states Business Names renew every three years in the original month of registration.

obligation.title: CIPA business-name renewal
obligation.description: Renew the Business Name in its applicable three-year renewal month.

rules.title: PAYE annual return and tax certificates
rules.summary: BURS PAYE guidance states every employer submits the annual PAYE return within 31 days after the tax year end and issues tax certificates within the same period.

obligation.title: PAYE annual return and ITW8 certificates
obligation.description: Submit the annual PAYE return and issue required employee tax certificates within 31 days after the Botswana tax year end.

rules.title: Industrial licence annual fee
rules.summary: Government trade eServices states industrial licences/registration certificates are indefinite and require an annual fee equal to 25% of the licence/certificate fee.

obligation.title: Industrial licence / registration annual fee
obligation.description: Pay the annual industrial licence/registration fee on the authority-confirmed annual fee date recorded for the business.

conflicts.description: Official BURS sources conflict on the compulsory VAT registration threshold: current FAQ/value-added-tax pages show P500,000 while registration guidance/brochure show P1,000,000. Do not automate threshold conclusions until resolved.
conflicts.resolutionNotes: Unresolved as of 31 Aug 2026. Current official BURS public sources conflict. Automated compulsory-registration threshold execution is disabled until authoritative 2026 implementation guidance or legislation is source-reviewed.

conflicts.description: Official BURS guidance conflicts on the monthly salary threshold referenced for ITW8/PAYE guidance: P3,000 versus P2,500. Do not automate threshold conclusions until resolved.
conflicts.resolutionNotes: Unresolved as of 31 Aug 2026. Current official BURS public guidance contains conflicting threshold references. Use current approved tax tables and taxpayer status; automated registration-threshold execution is disabled.

conflicts.description: Earlier official statement gave 1 July 2026; later ministerial statement on 19 August 2026 gave 1 September 2026.
conflicts.resolutionNotes: Use the later 19 August 2026 ministerial statement: commencement 1 September 2026. Retain earlier source as superseded historical context.
